The '''Quiet Return''' was a combat tactic employed by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. It consisted of hiding when an opponent was expecting an attack until the opponent finally grew tired and less alert, and only then springing the ambush. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] utilized the tactic in [[44 ABY]] inside the [[New Jedi Temple]] when the [[New Jedi Order]] attempted to [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|drive]] the Sith out.
